entries.3834e6197f1d645a: The communications business provides domestic SMS delivery, messaging services in Vietnam, and email delivery such as school safety email. The solutions business advances the commercialization of ANOTHER AI, which uses voice and facial image analysis technology, SchooMy for school education, GPU server-related work, and next-generation security technologies such as PQC. The investment and incubation business invests in and nurtures promising development-related and AI ventures, and group companies carry out promotion support such as advertising operations, the bid information platform "Nyusatsu-O," and the development of the "SMS+LINE" delivery platform.
entries.3ae068f55a065b14: In August 2024, it concluded a business alliance with Techown Information Technology Co., Ltd. concerning the SMS distribution business, and in the same August it acquired all shares of Zuno Media Solution Co., Ltd., an Internet advertising company. entries.3e4ee7dbc8f25df7: SMS delivery services provided by the company in Japan. The company also offers SNS-based messaging services such as LINE Mini Apps. In Japan, the average selling price continues to fall due to price competition with competitors, but the number of SMS messages delivered is increasing. Going forward, the company plans to make use of its advantage in the number of messages delivered in the SMS market to expand its business into SNS-based messages as well and to grow revenue.
entries.3f1b2cdf561c6abb: After relocating its head office to Taishido, Setagaya Ward, Tokyo, in December 2016, it listed its shares in July 2018 on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Mothers (now the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market).
entries.3fa19239d8e19a87: Messaging services provided by the Vietnamese subsidiary VietGuys J.S.C. (the company's voting rights ownership ratio: 51%, Ho Chi Minh City). In the fiscal year ended December 2025, diversification away from dependence on SMS advanced, with OTT (messages sent over the internet), various solutions and reward businesses growing, greatly changing the composition of sales. From 2026 onward, the company plans to shift to a strategy of building an integrated ecosystem based on industry-specific know-how and having customers use multiple services at the same time. This company's sales (excluding internal sales between consolidated companies) were ¥1,655,053 thousand, and it is a specified subsidiary accounting for more than 10% of consolidated sales.
entries.45058d06d48448b8: With the company and 7 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]], it has the messaging service business, including SMS, as its main business.
entries.459c6f0d98d993b9: The SMS distribution service is the company's starting point. According to management's analysis in the securities report, the company started the corporate SMS distribution business in 2010 and, since then, has created and led the corporate SMS distribution market in Japan. Messaging services, including SMS, are still the group's main business, and for the fiscal year ended December 2025, 29.9% of consolidated net sales were from the SMS distribution service via overseas aggregators.
entries.470b59518f13abaf: A segment that invests in promising development-focused and AI ventures and aims to take them in as business revenue, while using them internally at the Company and providing support to grow the invested companies' businesses (incubation). Its 3 [[term:segment|reportable segments]] are the Communication Business, the Solutions Business and the Investment and Incubation Business. Under its Medium-Term Management Plan [2025-2027], it has set the goal of moving beyond a single SMS business and is advancing the commercialization of new AI and security solutions. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥8,791,215 thousand, and revenue by reportable segment, including intersegment internal revenue, was ¥6,515,895 thousand for the Communication Business, ¥1,205,356 thousand for the Solutions Business and ¥1,182,453 thousand for the Investment and Incubation Business.
entries.867b76afb1a3aedb: The group's main business, in which the company and its subsidiaries provide messaging services, including the delivery of SMS (mobile phone short messages). The company started its SMS delivery business for corporate customers in 2010 and provides services to more than 5,300 companies. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales including internal sales between segments were ¥6,515,895 thousand (up 12.2% year on year) and segment profit (operating profit basis) was ¥1,136,464 thousand (up 88.1% year on year), with the number of SMS messages delivered both in Japan and via overseas aggregators increasing. 29.9% of consolidated sales came from SMS delivery services via overseas aggregators, and their trends are regarded as a factor with a significant impact on operating results. Contractual relationships with mobile carriers are likewise an important factor. In Japan, the average selling price continues to fall due to price competition with competitors.

The company is expanding its network of sales agents for high schools and aims to increase new learning areas and business models through cooperation with compulsory education, universities and local governments. From the fourth quarter consolidated accounting period of the fiscal year ended December 2025, part of the sales function was transferred to Technomix, which operates its business for elementary and junior high schools, and adoption through local governments is being promoted using its sales network.
